scripts.build: docker build -f Dockerfile.build -t gifwidgets-build . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/app" gifwidgets-build
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx serve frontend
scripts.test:backend: docker build -f Dockerfile.test-backend -t gifwidgets-test-backend . && docker run --rm gifwidgets-test-backend
scripts.test:e2e: docker build -f Dockerfile.test-e2e -t gifwidgets-test-e2e . && docker run --rm gifwidgets-test-e2e
scripts.test:load: docker build -f Dockerfile.test-load -t gifwidgets-test-load . && docker run --rm gifwidgets-test-load share-api.js
scripts.test:load:homepage: docker build -f Dockerfile.test-load -t gifwidgets-test-load . && docker run --rm gifwidgets-test-load homepage.js
